atDirectives.name: @nave
atDirectives.description:
The `@nave` at-rule applies one or more of Nave’s built-in atomic utilities to the CSS rule it appears in. Loading this file stops an editor from reporting `@nave` as an unknown at-rule and shows this description on hover; it does not complete atom names.

Display: flex, inlineFlex, grid, block, inlineBlock, hidden
Flex: flexCol, flexWrap, itemsCenter, itemsStart, itemsEnd, justifyCenter, justifyBetween, justifyEnd, flexGrow, flexShrink0, gap
Position: relative, absolute, insetFull
Sizing: wFull, hFull, minW0
Typography: truncate, srOnly, srOnlyFocusable, noWrap, breakWord, textLeft, textCenter, textRight
Interaction: interactive, focusRing, disabledState
Visual: rounded, roundedCard, roundedFull, border, overflowHidden, overflowAuto
Transition: transition
Containment: container
Responsive: hidePhoneOnly, hideTabletPortraitUp, hideTabletLandscapeUp, hideDesktopUp, stackPhoneOnly, wFullPhoneOnly

Atoms registered through `extend` are valid and are not listed here.
